caption: The left part delineates the operational procedure of TabUnit module in processing individual cells. The right part provides an overview of our UniTabE architecture. ``n'' denotes the number of cells in each example, ``Q'' denotes the length of prompt, while ``T'' here represents the length of target. A shallow decoder is applied offering adaptability to a spectrum of diverse downstream tasks. % The deliberate use of a shallow decoder serves the dual purpose of ensuring the capacity to retain acquired knowledge into the encoder while also offering adaptability to a spectrum of diverse downstream tasks.
